title: Sandiganbayan drops Samchan exec as co-accused in Martin Romualdez plunder case
summary: The Sandiganbayan Third Division has removed a businessman as a co-accused in the plunder case against former House speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, clearing the way for the former to testify for…

blocks.text: The Sandiganbayan Third Division has removed a businessman as a co-accused in the plunder case against former House speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, clearing the way for the former to testify for the prosecution.
In an 11-page resolution, the anti-graft court approved an amended charge sheet dropping Samchan Foreign Exchange Corp. president Felicito Guevarra from the case.
Prosecutors will now present Guevarra as a witness during the bail hearings, replacing former Public Works secretary Manuel Bonoan.

Guevarra surrendered himself to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and was granted conditional immunity "because his testimony and records are necessary to establish the truth in this case," according to the Office of the Ombudman.
The Ombudsman said the conditions are as follows:

items: Guevarra will cooperate fully and truthfully turn over all of Samchan's records and devices
he will remain in the Philippines
he will stay under the protection of the Department of Justice (DOJ)

blocks.text: The Sandignbayan ruled that prosecutors correctly followed the rules for removing an accused person before they enter a plea, rather than the stricter process for turning someone into a state witness.
"His (Guevarra) testimony and records will help the prosecution trace the movement of funds alleged in the charge sheet. The charges against the other accused stand as filed," the Ombudsman said.
The Sandiganbayan, meanwhile, noted that it "finds merit in the prosecution's contention thatGuevarra's willingness to testify against his co-accused is a supervening event."
The anti-graft court added that the Resolution issued by the Office of the Ombudsman directing the exclusion of Guevarra was issued only on November 20, 2026.

Due to security risks, the Sandiganbayan also granted the prosecution's request to keep Guevarra in the custody of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) while his application for the DOJ's Witness Protection Program is being processed. — VDV, GMA News
